accepted_result.review_scope: qstar frozen implementation/calibration/lock/validation/realCI/static; no training lift/strategy/sealed acceptance

G1_qstar.snapshot_rule: ACCEPTED_RESULT and final independent review govern acceptance; FINAL_RESULT retains historical pending field

canary.arm: Two staged canaries: M0 first (independent of index) and M4 after index binding; each covers horizons [1,2,5] in 2024H1.
canary.codes: At training cutoff, eligible codes sorted ascending and fixed to first 200 (or all if fewer); code choice cannot inspect test rows or labels.
canary.feature_warmup: Compute with full history before taking the 60-date canary slice.
canary.purpose: Both canaries check engineering, labels, shared-calendar shifts, stable Top10, saved-model replay and resources only; their returns do not gate lift.
canary.train_dates: Latest 60 available training signal dates, each with label_end_date < test_start.

INDEX_RECOVERY.index: TDX 000300 daily only; separate no-fit registered route

execution_stages.reuse: Each checkpoint binds its exact training key-set SHA and behavioral input/code/config SHAs. M0_CANARY is diagnostic-only and is not reused as a formal fit. M0_FORMAL starts only after index binding so its training keys share the frozen M0-M4 finite-feature intersection.

feature_arms.M0: V193 exact-source core features only; V192 XG is retained as a separate diagnostic and never filters candidates or enters model training. M0 canary and 18 formal cells may run after M0-only review activation without the index artifact, while retaining observed-panel and historical-eligibility limitations.
feature_arms.M1: M0 plus bound V193 index mapping: index MA5/MA20 positions, index 1/5-session returns, stock RS5, observed-panel advancer share, and amount activity. Missing official index-history input blocks this arm; no alternate index producer.
feature_arms.M2: M1 plus month one-hot category and AUDITM 3/4/12 outputs from the existing formula engine.
feature_arms.M3: M2 plus bound CAPCO industry category and 5/20-session industry mean return, advancer share, amount activity, and stock relative strength; retrospective classification status must remain explicit.
feature_arms.M4: M3 plus 0AMV_PROXY from observed QFQ-panel aggregate amount in CNY: recursive SMA(10, alpha=0.1), its 5-session change, ratio to its 20-session mean minus one, and SMA5/SMA13 minus one. This is an observed-panel proxy, not the official 0AMV algorithm.
feature_arms.selector_rule: V192 and V193 formula triggers are diagnostics only, never candidate hard filters. If a formula trigger yields more than 10 names, sort by max(FRESH,CONT0)-RISK0 then code; if fewer than 10, do not refill. Same-date same-N diagnostics remain separate.

folds.session_shift: Use the bound common trading-date index, never per-stock row shifts.
folds.test_label_access: Isolated evaluation only; selected keys/ranks are frozen before test labels are joined.
folds.train_window: Prior two calendar years ending before each test fold, after full-history feature warmup.

contract_historical_freeze.goal: Compare five nested research-only feature arms for daily A-share Top10 selection using close(T+h)/close(T)-1 for h=1,2,5, with no capital, position sizing, costs, NAV, or BUY integration.

governance.reviewer: Independent different-identity Luna Max read-only reviewer; inspect actual diff and rerun synthetic tests.
governance.stop_rule: Keep real data read and fit gates closed until independent pre-run review; if required index, calendar, eligibility, or field semantics remain unresolved, report exact CANNOT_CONFIRM and do not substitute another source or alter the frozen feature definition.

contract_historical_freeze.hypothesis: Market, month, retrospective industry, and observed aggregate amount-proxy features can improve date-equal Top10 close-return ranking over the shared V192/V193 volume-price core.

inputs.industry_use: CURRENT_CLASSIFICATION_RETROSPECTIVE per user decision; not historical PIT

official_index_history.original_tdx_evidence: CANNOT_CONFIRM: index_000300_official_history.csv is referenced by a manifest but absent from the available package; calendar rows are date ordinals, not index prices

price_panel.sha_basis: REUSED_EXISTING_ACTUAL_FIELD_PROJECTION_V2_RECEIPT; NOT REHASHED IN THIS PRE-RUN STAGE

labels.calendar_identity: CANNOT_CONFIRM_OFFICIAL_EXCHANGE_CALENDAR; bind to existing calendar member and retain observed-calendar limitation
labels.missing_target_close: NaN/unknown; never zero-filled and never used to remove a candidate or refill a Top10 slot

metrics_and_acceptance.bootstrap: Auxiliary only: 10-consecutive-trading-date moving blocks sampled within each fold; entire date clusters and identical sampled dates for both arms; 1000 replicates, seed 193; never changes the frozen acceptance gates.
metrics_and_acceptance.exposed_history_status: DIRECTION_ONLY; no sealed-forward validation and no promotion.
metrics_and_acceptance.median_rule: Median daily Top10 return for M4 is not below M0 over the paired common complete-label dates.
metrics_and_acceptance.missing_label_accounting: For each arm/horizon/fold, report selected slots, known labels, unknown labels, complete Top10 dates, excluded dates, and excluded slots. Unknown labels do not reorder or refill selections.
metrics_and_acceptance.other_arms: M1-M3 descriptive diagnostics only; no post-hoc winner combination or best-horizon claim.
metrics_and_acceptance.p10_rule: P10 is calculated over selected stock-date events (repeated codes on different dates remain separate), on the paired common complete-label dates; M4 P10 is not below M0.
metrics_and_acceptance.positive_fold_rule: At least 4 of 6 fold means of paired daily M4-M0 return delta are > 0.
metrics_and_acceptance.primary: For each horizon independently, M4 minus M0 paired mean Top10 close return over identical common dates where both unfilled Top10 lists have 10 known labels.

model.feature_nan_policy: Use only the pre-label common finite-feature key intersection across M0-M4; no imputation.
model.fit_weights: Equal total sample weight per signal date.

contract_historical_freeze.one_variable: Incremental feature group by arm M0 to M4; same algorithm, labels, common scoring keys, folds, and Top10 tie rule.

outputs.checkpoint_policy: Atomic durable output per fold-arm-horizon; reuse only a completed checkpoint matching contract/input/code/config SHAs. A failed/dangling RUN_STARTED is never auto-retried; diagnose before a new attempt id.
outputs.selected_returns: Three actual close-return label columns per selected stock/date, with unknown values retained as null.

contract_historical_freeze.prediction: For each horizon independently, M4 minus M0 has positive overall date-equal mean Top10 return delta, positive paired fold delta in at least four of six folds, and no lower median daily Top10 return or selected-event P10.

registration.append_path: Reuse the existing lock/canonical builder/fsync adapter path; never rewrite or reorder earlier events.
registration.status: No event appended in the pre-run review stage.

contract_historical_freeze.rejection_condition: For any horizon, any frozen primary acceptance gate fails, or a required source/field/calendar/eligibility binding is unresolved; no post-hoc feature, pool, fold, metric, threshold, or top-N changes.

resource_estimate.fit_shape: 90 formal fits plus 6 staged canary fits; each formal fit uses at most the prior two-year feature-complete rows for one horizon/arm.
resource_estimate.memory_and_duration: CANNOT_CONFIRM before the approved canary; feature materialization is full-history and may dominate memory. Record actual duration and peak RSS at canary before full fits.

universe.industry_unknown: Preserve as unknown; no inferred industry fill
